scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Real pointwise Jordan BV, classical Bernstein sampling, Lebesgue L1 error, all integer degrees n>=1; explicit finite maximum plus sharp Gaussian asymptotic and localization
scientific_integrity.limitations: No closed finite argmax index or next-order asymptotic; full historical priority unresolved for Cheng 1983 and Bustamante et al. 2014. No independent external validation.

title: Exact integrated bounded-variation error norm for Bernstein approximation and its Gaussian localization
